welcome.title: Welcome to Pocket Ahead
welcome.subtitle: A clear plan for your money, bills, goals, and daily spending
welcome.description: Pocket Ahead is not a generic expense tracker. We interview you, understand your complete life situation, and build a realistic, honest financial path that actually works.
welcome.privacyNotice: Your data is private and stored securely.
welcome.referenceTitle: A financial plan built around your real life.
welcome.referenceDescription: Take control of your future with a personalized roadmap. Plan your spending, track your goals, and find stability in every decision.

onboarding.reviewSubtitle: Please review and confirm your details. We use this to calculate your plan.
onboarding.essentialSubtitle: These are the expenses identified as essential to your survival and safety. You can adjust them.

preferredName.title: What should we call you?
preferredName.subtitle: We want to address you personally.

country.title: Which country do you live in?
country.subtitle: This helps us suggest correct cultural events and tax rules.

city.title: Which city do you live in?
city.subtitle: Used for regional cost estimation.

employmentStatus.title: What is your current employment status?
employmentStatus.subtitle: Helps determine income stability.

hasIncome.title: Do you currently receive income?
hasIncome.subtitle: This includes salaries, freelance, business, or support.

mainIncome.title: What is your main monthly income?
mainIncome.subtitle: Enter your net take-home monthly amount.

incomeFrequency.title: How often do you receive this income?
incomeFrequency.subtitle: Select the payment frequency.

incomeType.title: Is this income fixed or irregular?
incomeType.subtitle: Fixed means stable salary; irregular means freelance, seasonal, etc.

nextIncomeDate.title: When do you expect your next income?
nextIncomeDate.subtitle: Pocket Ahead uses this date to calculate how long your available money must last.

hasSecondIncome.title: Do you have a second source of income?
hasSecondIncome.subtitle: Any secondary job, rent, or side hustle.

secondIncome.title: What is your monthly second income amount?
secondIncome.subtitle: Net monthly amount.

secondIncomeSource.title: What is the source of your second income?
secondIncomeSource.subtitle: Example: Freelance, rent, part-time.

hasRent.title: Do you pay rent?
hasRent.subtitle: Select yes if you lease your home.

hasMortgage.title: Do you have a mortgage?
hasMortgage.subtitle: Select yes if you are buying your home.

housingAmount.title: What is your monthly housing payment?
housingAmount.subtitle: Enter your rent or mortgage monthly cost.

shareHousing.title: Do you share housing costs?
shareHousing.subtitle: Do you divide rent/mortgage with a partner or flatmate?

supportOtherHousehold.title: Do you financially support another household?
supportOtherHousehold.subtitle: For example, sending money to parents or relatives in a different home.

isMarried.title: Are you married?
isMarried.subtitle: Used to evaluate joint cost factors.

hasChildren.title: Do you have children?
hasChildren.subtitle: Select yes if you have dependents.

numChildren.title: How many children do you have?
numChildren.subtitle: Dependents under your care.

schoolFees.title: Do you pay school fees for children?
schoolFees.subtitle: Enter the total monthly school or tuition fees.

childcareExpenses.title: Do you pay for childcare or nursery?
childcareExpenses.subtitle: Total monthly childcare expenses.

supportRelatives.title: Do you support parents or other relatives?
supportRelatives.subtitle: Regular financial support for extended family.

hasVehicle.title: Do you own or regularly use a car or motorcycle?
hasVehicle.subtitle: Select your vehicle status.

vehicleFinancing.title: Do you have vehicle financing or a car loan?
vehicleFinancing.subtitle: Select yes if you are paying off the vehicle.

vehiclePayment.title: What is your monthly vehicle loan payment?
vehiclePayment.subtitle: Enter the financing amount.

fuelSpending.title: What is your estimated monthly fuel spending?
fuelSpending.subtitle: Gas, diesel, or charging costs.

vehicleInsurance.title: Do you pay annual vehicle insurance?
vehicleInsurance.subtitle: Insurance premium paid annually or semi-annually.

insuranceAmount.title: What is your annual vehicle insurance amount?
insuranceAmount.subtitle: Total premium paid.

insuranceDate.title: When is your next insurance payment due?
insuranceDate.subtitle: This helps us calculate savings preparation time.

roadTax.title: Do you pay annual road tax / vignette?
roadTax.subtitle: Annual government vehicle tax.

taxAmount.title: What is your annual road tax amount?
taxAmount.subtitle: Road tax value.

vehicleMaintenance.title: What is your expected monthly maintenance spending?
vehicleMaintenance.subtitle: Repairs, washing, servicing.

medicationExpenses.title: Do you have regular medication expenses?
medicationExpenses.subtitle: Monthly cost of necessary medications.

medicalAppointments.title: Do you have recurring medical appointments?
medicalAppointments.subtitle: Therapy, physiotherapy, specialist appointments.

supportOtherHealthcare.title: Do you support another person's healthcare expenses?
supportOtherHealthcare.subtitle: Paying medical bills for parents, children, etc.

hasDebt.title: Do you currently have debt?
hasDebt.subtitle: Credit cards, personal loans, consumer credit (excluding mortgage/car loan).

electricity.title: What is your average monthly electricity bill?
electricity.subtitle: Power utility expenses.

water.title: What is your average monthly water bill?
water.subtitle: Water utility expenses.

internet.title: What is your monthly internet bill?
internet.subtitle: Home broadband connections.

phone.title: What is your monthly mobile phone bill?
phone.subtitle: Call and data subscriptions.

subscriptions.title: What is your total monthly subscriptions cost?
subscriptions.subtitle: Streaming, gym, software, etc.

groceries.title: What is your estimated monthly groceries budget?
groceries.subtitle: Essential food and household supplies.

otherBills.title: What is your total other monthly recurring bills?
otherBills.subtitle: Any other recurring payments.

annualBills.title: Do you have other annual or occasional bills?
annualBills.subtitle: Examples: school registration, property tax, maintenance, checkups.

spendingHabits.title: Respectful Review of Spending Habits
spendingHabits.subtitle: We do not judge. This is to understand areas you wish to improve.

culturalPref.title: Religion & Cultural Preferences (Optional)
culturalPref.subtitle: This is only used to suggest important future events (e.g. Ramadan, Eid). You can skip this question.

profile.title: Profile
profile.resetConfirmMessage: This will erase all your onboarding answers, transactions, and custom goals. This action cannot be undone.
profile.devNoticeText: These tools are shown only during development builds. They are automatically hidden in release production builds.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.securityDesc: Critical warnings about active sessions, password alterations, and login activities.
notifications.billsDesc: Get notified about upcoming recurring bills 3 days before their due dates.
notifications.debtsDesc: Alerts when a debt payment is scheduled or overdue.
notifications.savingsDesc: Reminders to deposit savings into your Emergency Fund or active targets.
notifications.goalsDesc: Alerts when goal targets are near or reached.
notifications.weeklyDesc: A brief summary of your expenditures and savings performance every Sunday.
notifications.monthlyDesc: In-depth breakdown of budget accuracy and surplus allocations.
notifications.culturalDesc: Polite prompts for specific expense predictions, such as Eid or Ramadan prep.
notifications.productDesc: Stay updated with new features and enhancements in Pocket Ahead.
notifications.marketingDesc: Promotions, financial articles, and general advisory materials.

security.title: Security
security.changePasswordDesc: Sends a secure reset link to your email
security.biometricDesc: Use FaceID / TouchID fingerprint verification to unlock the app
security.purgeDesc: Delete all saved financial records, assessments, credentials, and authentication sessions. This action is permanent and immediate.

privacy.title: Privacy Centre
privacy.policyDesc: We process your financial entries strictly to construct budgets, analyze debt reduction tracks, and project savings targets. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.sensitiveDesc: Pocket Ahead can use this optional information to suggest relevant cultural or religious expenses. It will not be used for advertising or determining your financial eligibility. You can remove it at any time.
privacy.culturalDesc: Explicit consent to use religious/cultural event suggestions
privacy.crashDesc: Collect anonymous bug reports and performance benchmarks
privacy.marketingDesc: Receive suggestions about partner products or updates

exportData.title: Export My Data
exportData.portabilityDesc: You have the right to receive all personal data you provided to Pocket Ahead in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.
exportData.portabilityDesc2: Tapping the export button below will securely compile your profile settings, onboarding questionnaire answers, debts, target savings goals, transactions ledger, and consent history.
exportData.readyDesc: Your data package is ready. You can copy the raw JSON text or share/save it as a text file.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.purgeDesc: Initiating account deletion will remove all information linked to your profile from Pocket Ahead servers:
deleteAccount.bullet2: All income items, recurring bills, and annual expenses.
deleteAccount.bullet3: All personal savings goals and transaction logs.
deleteAccount.bullet4: All login credentials and active browser/device sessions.
deleteAccount.purgeDesc2: Pocket Ahead does not retain any financial information post-deletion. Once completed, your credentials will immediately expire and your sessions will be revoked.
deleteAccount.confirmDesc: To proceed, please type **DELETE** in all capital letters in the field below.

help.title: Help & Support
help.detailsDesc: Need assistance or have feedback? Submit a support ticket or contact our developer team.
help.detailsDesc2: Support availability and response times may vary.
help.detailsDesc3: Use Contact Support or Report a Problem to open your email app.

about.title: App & System Info
about.devDesc: Pocket Ahead is published by Kael Labs. Financial calculations are produced by deterministic planning rules based on the information you enter.
